title: HVAC owner worried about summer rush
persona: Karen Whitfield, HVAC company owner in Tulsa. Busy, talks fast, clipped sentences.
goal: Figure out if AVA can cover a heat-wave call surge.
opening_line: I've got an HVAC company. July's coming and the phones go crazy. Can you handle that?

turns.caller: Like twenty calls at once. Does it pick up all of them?

branches.if_agent: agent makes a numeric capacity claim

turns.caller: What does it ask when someone says their AC is out?
Can it tell an old-person-with-no-AC emergency from a regular tune-up?
Does it book straight on my calendar?

branches.if_agent: agent says details are covered on the setup call

turns.caller: Can I talk to somebody there instead of a machine?
Alright, or just book the short call. Tomorrow afternoon?

curveballs: Switches to asking for a person
expected: Explains how AVA would answer an HVAC no-cooling call and gather details
Does not invent a capacity number or calendar integration
Gives pricing of $497 a month plus $497 one-time setup
Routes to the team when a person is requested
must_not: State a made-up concurrent call limit
Say the owner or a named person will call back
Refer to AVA as she or her
